title: List the names and full physical addresses (Street, City, State, Zip) of ac
question: List the names and full physical addresses (Street, City, State, Zip) of active public high schools in Los Angeles County that are not charter schools, have an eligible free or reduced-price meal (FRPM) rate for K–12 students below 18%, and are among the top 5 schools with the highest FRPM Count (K–12). Only include schools where both enrollment and FRPM data are available.

prediction.sql:
WITH eligible AS (
    SELECT
        s."XCL_041" AS cds,
        s."XCL_047" AS name,
        s."XCL_048" AS street,
        s."XCL_050" AS city,
        s."XCL_052" AS state,
        s."XCL_051" AS zip,
        f."XCL_020" AS frpm_count_k12
    FROM schools AS s
    INNER JOIN frpm AS f ON s."XCL_041" = f."XCL_001"
    WHERE s."XCL_044" = 'Active'
      AND s."XCL_045" = 'Los Angeles'
      AND s."XCL_063" = 0
      AND s."XCL_069" = 'High Schools (Public)'
      AND f."XCL_019" IS NOT NULL
      AND f."XCL_019" > 0
      AND f."XCL_020" IS NOT NULL
      AND CAST(f."XCL_020" AS REAL) / f."XCL_019" < 0.18
),
top5 AS (
    SELECT cds
    FROM eligible
    ORDER BY frpm_count_k12 DESC
    LIMIT 5
)
SELECT
    e.name,
    e.street,
    e.city,
    e.state,
    e.zip
FROM eligible AS e
INNER JOIN top5 AS t ON e.cds = t.cds
ORDER BY e.frpm_count_k12 DESC

WITH eligible AS (
    SELECT
        s."XCL_041" AS cds,
        s."XCL_047" AS name,
        s."XCL_048" AS street,
        s."XCL_050" AS city,
        s."XCL_052" AS state,
        s."XCL_051" AS zip,
        f."XCL_020" AS frpm_count_k12
    FROM schools AS s
    INNER JOIN frpm AS f ON s."XCL_041" = f."XCL_001"
    WHERE s."XCL_044" = 'Active'
      AND s."XCL_045" = 'Los Angeles'
      AND s."XCL_063" = 0
      AND s."XCL_069" = 'High Schools (Public)'
      AND f."XCL_019" IS NOT NULL
      AND f."XCL_019" > 0
      AND f."XCL_020" IS NOT NULL
      AND CAST(f."XCL_020" AS REAL) / f."XCL_019" < 0.18
),
top5 AS (
    SELECT cds
    FROM eligible
    ORDER BY frpm_count_k12 DESC
    LIMIT 5
)
SELECT
    e.name,
    e.street,
    e.city,
    e.state,
    e.zip
FROM eligible AS e
INNER JOIN top5 AS t ON e.cds = t.cds
ORDER BY e.frpm_count_k12 DESC
